title: Inspect AI WRAP spike: run one EVS suite through an Inspect bridge
observation: PA-inspect-ai is the strongest WRAP candidate for evaluation breadth (sandboxes, resumable eval sets, benchmark ports), but it is API-provider-centric and heavy.
suggested_direction: In a throwaway venv, implement an Inspect custom ModelAPI that calls Agent OS routes (delegate or the API adapter) and run EVS-TEST-SELECTION as an Inspect task; measure lines of glue, dependency count and whether results map back to an EVR. Decide WRAP/REJECT in a DEC.
acceptance: Spike results recorded (glue size, dependencies, fidelity)
Decision recorded in the prior-art registry
